notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's pose writer has the three client-volunteered body-state sends: CMSG_SETSHEATHED (u32 state), CMSG_STANDSTATECHANGE (u32 state, values 0/1/3/8), CMSG_MOUNTSPECIAL_ANIM (empty). MSUI sends only the sheath state; the other two have no sender.
